reason: A DeepSeek Harness canvas plugin for rendering HTML prototypes, annotating previews, and reviewing visual designs in a dedicated interface tab.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供画布页签，用于渲染 HTML 设计稿并添加位置标注和文字备注。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness canvas tab for rendering HTML prototypes and adding positional annotations and text notes.

capabilities: Renders HTML content in a canvas preview
Fetches remote HTTP or HTTPS pages for preview
Provides model and HTTP APIs for rendering, annotation, and clearing canvas state
Runs preview page scripts, forms, modals, and popups in a sandboxed iframe
Stores canvas state in host memory for the session
